name: ChartTooltip
summary: Values under the pointer, on the same tooltip surface as the rest of Aurea.

a11y.apg: none as a widget: the value box follows the pointer and is not focusable. What a keyboard or screen reader user gets instead is the engine's accessibility layer on the chart itself, which announces each point as the arrow keys move through it.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Pins the tooltip to one data point instead of following the pointer. Written for a page with no pointer — a static preview, a print, a screenshot.

props.name: cursor
props.description: The mark the engine draws under the pointer. `false` removes it.

props.name: …Tooltip
props.description: Everything else goes to the engine's Tooltip. `content` is the exception: it is what this component IS, so passing it would replace the Aurea surface.
